answer_1.quote: we propose an abstractive opinion summarization model that generates aspect-controllable summaries.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the quality of general and aspect-specific opinion summaries using F1 ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We conducted several human elicitation studies to further analyze the summaries produced by competing systems using the Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdsourcing platform.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to select the best and worst among system summaries, taking into account the following criteria: Informativeness, Coherence, Conciseness, and Fluency.
